propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export 3,019 checkout files but production hatch_build.py consumes only three (hook, pyproject.toml, src/rebar/__init__.py), amplifying build time across xdist workers
Artifact probe on Gerrit patchsets builds with trusted-main GITHUB_SHA instead of derived final checkout HEAD, accepting wrong but nonempty SHA that violates exact-source identity
Build-hook session fixtures initialize independently on all three xdist workers, each incurring 6.60-6.74s setup, tripling unavoidable costs
Minimal fixture on unchanged production hook preserves exact fallback SHA while reducing paired totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s, proving fixture scale is root cause not hook logic
Workflow artifact lanes require exact equality assertion between installed wheel/sdist and final checkout SHA, not truthiness-only probes
